verdict.rationale: Isaac's own SDKs do reach real hardware: Isaac ROS deploys navigation, manipulation, and teleoperation packages on Jetson, and Isaac Lab packages policies into bundles for real robots. Isaac Lab also ships agent skills, but those cover developer tasks like installation and training rather than commanding a robot. Nothing shows an AI agent authenticating with scoped credentials or driving a physical robot end-to-end through a platform API, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. missing for 10: scoped credential or authentication model, an agent-facing API for commanding real robots, a documented end-to-end agent-to-robot workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
